Always use tools like "ask user" when done with a task, to ask the user if they want to continue with the next task or if they have any questions. This will help ensure that the user is engaged and has a clear understanding of the tasks being performed. Additionally, it allows for any necessary adjustments to be made based on user feedback before proceeding to the next step.
